status.zh: 开放求职 · 研发 / 仿真 / 材料

intro.zh: 以实验理解软材料，以模型连接工程。聚焦粘弹性、界面失效与有限元分析，将材料行为转化为可验证的工程判断。
intro.en: I connect experiments, constitutive models and finite element analysis to understand soft materials—and turn complex behavior into verifiable engineering insight.

title.zh: 软材料空泡与界面失效

description.zh: 结合力学测试、全场图像分析与有限元建模，研究粘弹性胶层中的空泡增长、指状失稳与损伤演化。
description.en: Combining mechanical testing, full-field image analysis and finite element modeling to study cavity growth, fingering and damage in viscoelastic adhesive layers.

label.zh: 软材料力学 / 失效量化

challenge.zh: 柔性器件中的薄胶层承受复杂的弯曲、剪切与法向载荷。局部失效的起点和演化过程难以通过整体力–位移曲线直接辨识。
challenge.en: Thin adhesive layers in flexible devices experience combined bending, shear and normal loading. Global force–displacement measurements alone cannot resolve local failure initiation and evolution.

methods.zh: 设计剥离与受限胶层测试方案；利用图像处理跟踪空泡和指状结构；结合粘弹性参数识别、本构分析与 Abaqus 模拟解释变形及失效。
methods.en: Design peel and confined-layer experiments; track cavities and fingers with image processing; combine viscoelastic parameter identification, constitutive analysis and Abaqus simulations.

contribution.zh: 建立从可视化观测到定量表征的分析路径，为柔性显示胶层的失效评估提供机理依据。
contribution.en: Connect visual observations to quantitative analysis, providing a mechanistic basis for failure assessment of flexible-display adhesives.

title.zh: 导热界面材料的压缩与回弹

subtitle.zh: 让柔软的界面，支撑可靠的封装。

description.zh: 围绕芯片封装中的导热界面材料，开展压缩、循环加载和松弛表征，识别软化与回弹行为并构建材料模型。
description.en: Characterizing compression, cyclic loading and relaxation of thermal interface materials, with constitutive models for softening and recovery in chip packaging.

label.zh: 芯片封装 / 材料建模

challenge.zh: 导热垫的非线性压缩、循环软化和恢复行为会影响装配接触状态；结构翘曲使材料响应更加复杂。
challenge.en: Nonlinear compression, cyclic softening and recovery affect the contact state of thermal pads. Structural warpage further complicates their mechanical response.

methods.zh: 开展拉伸、流变、压缩与循环加载测试；识别粘弹性和 Mullins 软化参数；结合仿真–实验对比研究尺寸、压缩平行度与结构翘曲的影响。
methods.en: Conduct tensile, rheological, compression and cyclic tests; identify viscoelastic and Mullins-softening parameters; compare simulations and experiments to assess size, compression alignment and warpage effects.

contribution.zh: 为导热界面材料的装配分析提供可验证的力学输入，支持封装结构中软化及回弹行为的评估。
contribution.en: Provide validated mechanical inputs for assembly analysis and support assessment of softening and recovery in packaging structures.

title.zh: 相机减震胶的动态响应

subtitle.zh: 从试样测试，走向模组验证。
subtitle.en: From material coupons to camera modules.

description.zh: 结合固化工艺、落锤冲击、扫频与时温等效分析，建立粘弹性本构模型，连接材料级响应与相机模组的振动表现。
description.en: Linking curing conditions, impact testing, frequency sweeps and time–temperature superposition to viscoelastic models and camera-module response.

label.zh: 消费电子 / 动态测试

challenge.zh: 减震胶的动态响应随频率、温度和固化条件变化，需要建立材料测试与真实模组响应之间的联系。
challenge.en: Damping adhesives respond differently across frequency, temperature and curing conditions. Material-level tests must be connected to module-level behavior.

methods.zh: 协助优化 UV 固化条件；搭建高速落锤冲击测试平台；通过扫频、时温等效与松弛试验构建粘弹性模型，并开展试样级和模组级对比验证。
methods.en: Support UV-curing optimization; develop a high-speed drop-weight impact test platform; build viscoelastic models using frequency sweeps, time–temperature superposition and relaxation tests; validate at coupon and module levels.

contribution.zh: 建立覆盖材料表征、参数识别与动态响应验证的技术路径，支持相机减震性能分析。
contribution.en: Establish a workflow spanning characterization, parameter identification and dynamic validation to support camera damping analysis.

title.zh: 可切换粘附的表皮电极

subtitle.zh: 稳定贴合，也能温和脱离。

description.zh: 通过皮肤–电极协同变形与结构设计，探索稳定粘附和低损伤脱离的兼容路径。相关成果发表于 Advanced Materials。
description.en: Exploring how skin–electrode co-deformation and structural design reconcile stable adhesion with gentle detachment. Published in Advanced Materials.

label.zh: 柔性电子 / 粘附力学

challenge.zh: 表皮电极需要稳定贴合以采集信号，同时又应易于移除，降低对皮肤的损伤。
challenge.en: Epidermal electrodes must adhere securely for signal acquisition while remaining easy to remove with limited skin damage.

methods.zh: 研究结构化电极与柔软皮肤基底的协同变形，以及不同剥离方向下的粘附切换机理；将软材料力学与柔性器件结构设计相结合。
methods.en: Study co-deformation of patterned electrodes and soft skin, and the mechanism of direction-dependent adhesion; connect soft-material mechanics with structural design of flexible devices.

contribution.zh: 共同第一作者论文：Coordinated Skin-Electrode Deformation for Switchable Adhesion and Injury-Free Detachment of Epidermal Electrodes，Advanced Materials，2026。
contribution.en: Co-first author of “Coordinated Skin-Electrode Deformation for Switchable Adhesion and Injury-Free Detachment of Epidermal Electrodes,” Advanced Materials, 2026.

heading.zh:
不只会模拟。
让模型经得起实验。
heading.en:
Beyond simulation.
Models that meet experiments.

intro.zh: 我的工作方式，是把实验、理论与计算放在同一个问题里，持续校准假设、参数和预测。
intro.en: My approach puts experiments, theory and computation in the same loop—checking assumptions, identifying parameters and validating predictions.

text.zh: DMA、流变、剥离脱粘、压缩与循环加载；围绕问题设计夹具与测试流程。
text.en: DMA, rheometry, peel and debonding, compression and cyclic loading; fixtures and test protocols built around the question.

text.zh: 粘弹性与超弹性、Prony 参数识别、Mullins 软化；以可辨识的参数描述材料行为。
text.en: Viscoelasticity, hyperelasticity, Prony identification and Mullins softening, with parameters grounded in material measurements.

text.zh: Abaqus 有限元分析、大变形与界面问题；通过实验–仿真对比检查模型适用范围。
text.en: Abaqus finite element analysis of large deformation and interfaces; experiment–simulation comparisons to check model validity.

text.zh: MATLAB 图像与数据处理，Git 与 LaTeX 组织研究；持续完善图表–代码–数据映射。
text.en: MATLAB image and data processing, Git and LaTeX for research organization; developing figure–code–data traceability.

p1.zh: 我是周伟裕，研究方向是固体力学与软材料。我的博士阶段研究在南方科技大学开展，围绕粘弹性材料、粘附与失效机制展开。
p1.en: I am Weiyu Zhou, a researcher in solid mechanics and soft materials. My doctoral research at SUSTech focuses on viscoelastic materials, adhesion and failure mechanisms.

p2.zh: 在产业合作项目中，我把这些研究方法用于柔性显示胶层、相机减震材料与芯片封装导热界面，希望用可验证的模型帮助团队理解问题、缩小设计与试验之间的距离。
p2.en: Through industry–university projects, I apply these methods to flexible-display adhesives, camera damping materials and thermal interfaces for chip packaging. I aim to help teams understand problems through validated models and bring design closer to testing.
